lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of vertically aligned high-luminance circular clusters forming at least five distinct columns posterior to the gill region. In the most prominent central column, four blobs are arranged with approximately equal vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear regions of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement where blobs serve as nodes on the vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries, running parallel to the dorsal midline.
